title: Warm Smoky Malaysian Chicken Curry
description: A herbal and snappy Malaysian dish featuring chicken cooked in a smoky curry sauce, served with a side of fluffy 00-flour roti, this recipe is perfect for a date night and is Buddhist-temple-friendly as it does not contain any animal by-products or alcohol
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a kadhai over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly
Add the smoked paprika, curry powder, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly
Add the chicken breast pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides and cooked through
Add the coconut milk and stir to combine, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes
While the curry is simmering, mix the 00-flour with a small amount of water to form a dough
Knead the dough for 5 minutes, then divide it into 4-6 pieces and roll each piece into a ball
Roll each ball of dough out into a thin circle and cook in a dry kadhai over medium heat for 1-2 minutes on each side
Serve the curry with the 00-flour roti and garnish with chopped fresh herbs
